name: lawdb
description: LawDB.ca - Canadian lawyer directory (static site + Cloudflare Worker API + D1 database)

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/lib/*.js src/routes/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.deploy:ci: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && npm run db:seed:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:seed:update:remote: node scripts/build-seed.mjs --update && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=db/seed.sql
